summaryShort: Their familiar patterns press against how freely you present yourself and enter situations.
summaryDeep: Their familiar patterns press against how freely you present yourself and enter situations. What is comfortable to them keeps casting you as someone you used to be. The familiarity is warm, and it argues quietly against you becoming anyone new.
